description: Measure a file against a named working set of lenses and get back only what that question needs. Profiles: voice (is this take usable, and which phrase is the problem), master (will this translate to real platforms and speakers), provenance (what has been done to this file, and is it all one source), dataset (which of these files are good enough, and why not the rest), environment (what is in this space, and what kind of noise is it), broadcast (does this file meet the delivery spec), loop (is this loop clean, on the grid, and safe to drop in a DAW), room (how long does this room ring, per octave band with series:true, and is there a flutter echo; needs a recording of one clap, a balloon pop, an impulse response or a sweep), chain (did this recording lose packets on its way: gaps of digital silence), pitch (where does this voice sit, how much does it move, how clean is it). basic is the free tier; the other ten need a paid plan. Results are keyed by stable lens id. Only the analysis passes the profile needs are run. Set series:true to also get the curves, the per-block lanes and the per-phrase values, a much larger payload, so leave it off unless you are going to read them. Set liveEvents:true to also get liveEvents: the file read as a stream by the live monitor, with every dropout, clipping, level drop, dead air and hum event, its times and its reason. Status signals: none of these detectors has been validated on live streams yet, so say "a signal", never "detected". A dropout or clipping event names the file measure with its own rule (chain.dropoutCount, signal.clipping) and why the two can differ. The answer carries measureStatus: per field its status (validated, proxy, beta, withdrawn), basis and margin where known. Report a proxy as an approximation, never present a withdrawn field as what its name says, and stay inside a stated margin (https://audiolab.tools/docs/start/read-a-response#the-five-statuses). Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

contentModel.description: Content-type model: v1 (the default until 15 January 2027) or v2 (the newer small learned model).

liveEvents.description: Also return liveEvents: the events of the live monitor over the whole file, status signals. Off by default.

measureStatus.description: Add measureStatus to the answer: the status of each field. On by default; set false to leave it out.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine. It is read here and uploaded to the AudioLab API for measuring, so you do not need to host it publicly (files up to 4 MB go in the request body; larger ones, up to 150 MB, upload over a signed URL and are swept from storage within the hour). Provide exactly one of url or path.

roomSource.description: For the room profile: how the recording was made. clap (default): one clap; balloon: one pop; impulse: the file is an impulse response; sweep: the file holds the sweep of the engine as the room returned it.

round.description: Round numbers to what they are worth (dB and LUFS 2 decimals, seconds 3, ms 1, Hz 1, shares 3); same keys and types. On by default; set false for full precision.

series.description: Include time series, per-block lanes and per-phrase arrays. Off by default.

spectrumCalc.description: Spectrum calculation: v1 (the default until 15 February 2027) or v2 (fixes three errors found against an independent calculation; values change a little, keys do not).

speechDetector.description: Speech detector: v1 (the default until 15 January 2027) or k2 (lets a phrase run on into its soft word starts and endings, at most 100 ms per side).

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

name: analyze_profile
title: Analyse against a profile
